title: spec: compose object-conflict refusal: pin the one unpinned preserve cell, add two admit CONTROLs, correct the changeset's before/error-text wording (follow-up of #32516)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

立卡门 ① · 已落地工作欠的后续：#32516（PR #32652）合约审查 should-fix 2–4 与专题红线读 6819900035 finding 2、3。按 Bill 规则「简单的问题后续单独立卡」（Bill，项目聊天）从 PR 中拆出。Part of #31527 (ADR-0150)。Blocked-by #32652.

## What

PR #32652 refuses `STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT` (422) in `composeStacks` for three shapes. The behaviour is correct and pinned; these loose ends were left for a separate PR:

1. One refused cell has no pin: under `'preserve'`, a flat input with a manifest beside a nested input that carries the name at its top level only.
2. Two admit-side CONTROLs are missing: two manifest-less inputs under `'preserve'` with override/merge, and a nested top-only name beside a flat input under the default manifest. Both should still reconcile.
3. The changeset's "Before" omits the shape-3 loose-first cell under override/preserve (correct on main), and its "error text unchanged" is exact only for the `'error'` walk and issue lines: the message header/explanation for cells #32495 already refused changed (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` ~7849-7861). Code, status and issues are unchanged. A follow-up `.changeset/` note (or an edit of #32652's changeset before release) states both.
4. Stale comment at `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts:602-605`; tautological precondition at `app-artifact-handlers.test.ts:250`; over-long docblock line at `stack.zod.ts:8479`. Existing CONTROLs assert names rather than full equality.

## Acceptance

- Pins for item 1 (red under ablation of the refusal) and CONTROLs for item 2 (full-equality assertions).
- Changeset wording per item 3; comment and test cleanups per item 4.
- `Clause-②: no` (test/wording only); no behaviour change.

## 业务理由

谁受益：维护 compose 的开发者和读发布说明的作者。场景：发布说明说「报错文本不变」，但 #32495 已拒绝的格子标题变了。不做：一个拒绝格子无 pin 可被悄悄回退，发布说明有一句不准确。

## 读者

server 车道，PR #32652 合并后；起点 `packages/spec/src/compose-stacks*.test.ts`、`.changeset/` 与上列行号。

## 查重

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT` → #32516 (the code card), #32661 (ADR-0130 amendment). No duplicate.
